simulation_comment.title: V4: Prueba corta de ajustes GREEDY, RANDOM, FORJA y ENJAMBRE antes de elegir balance candidato.

changes.detail: Opt-in simulations convert each building level above 1 into +0.5% starting reserve, capped at +12%; four level-5 buildings yield +8% (300 to 324 resources).
Simulation profiles can equip Breaker, Siege, or Fast doctrines on either bot so missile research effects use the actual Arena combat code.
Add opt-in test knobs for GREEDY economy/attack timing and weighted RANDOM legal actions; no change when simulations omit these settings.
Add paired tuning arms for bot behavior and FORJA/ENJAMBRE PvP costs, resetting civilization rules before every matchup; preserve every run as a versioned JSON snapshot.

simulation_comment.comparison: All scenarios use the same bot/civilization matchups and seed schedule; baseline results are included in this file.

meta.engine: Interactive Arena Match engine loaded from public/arena.html
meta.method: Each cross-civilization bot pair is simulated with both A/B side assignments and identical seed schedules across scenarios.
meta.reserveFormula: +0.5% starting resources for every persistent building level above the four starting levels, capped at +12%.

candidateBotTuning.GREEDY: Growth factor 2.05; stop factory expansion at 120 s; delay attacks to 115 s.
candidateBotTuning.RANDOM: Action chance 82%; legal action weights favor economy, rockets, defense, and capture over sabotage.

candidateCivilizationTuning.FORGE: Economic upgrade cost 0.93 to 0.90; attack cost 1.08 to 1.04.

meta.factoryBonusNote: Normal Ranked gameplay is unchanged. The Arena hook applies only when enableSimulationFactoryLink is explicitly set by this runner.
